entries.source: Archiv der Evangelischen Kirche im Rheinland, 8SL 033, Nr. 16
entries.english:
Circular letters

Guidelines of the German Christian Faith Movement (DC), 26 May 1932; handwritten copy of the Church Law Gazette of 5 July 1933; general membership meeting of the DC Faith Movement, Greater Berlin regional branch, at the Sports Palace on 13 Nov. 1933 (carbon-copy minutes); latest DC guidelines, decree of the Reich Leader, December 1933; circulars from Reich Leader Dr. Kinder (no. 45) and the Reich leadership; “Training letter to refute the latest claims of our opponents,” 1 Sep. 1934; DC Reich conference, Berlin, 14–16 Sep. 1934; decrees; report on the church situation submitted by Bishop Hossenfelder, chair of the DC faction in the Church Senate (copy); “The propaganda struggle against the Church” (carbon copy), 6 and 7 Nov. 1934; general recruitment letter from Hossenfelder inviting people to join the DC Faith Movement; copy of “Rosenberg at the Reich Cultural Conference 1938” (carbon copy); DC Faith Movement in Mecklenburg; League of National Socialist Protestant Clergy; principles for a new order of the German Evangelical Church suited to contemporary requirements, 1939.
